clauses.signature: int read_input(int *k, long long p[])
clauses.code: int read_input(int *k, long long p[]) { int n; scanf("%d%d", &n, k); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) scanf("%lld", &p[i]); return n; }

clauses.signature: long long compute(int pos, int chosen[], int k)
clauses.code: long long compute(int pos, int chosen[], int k) { long long min_dist = 1000000000; for(int i = 0; i < k; i++) { long long d = pos > chosen[i] ? pos - chosen[i] : chosen[i] - pos; if(d < min_dist) min_dist = d; } return min_dist; }

clauses.signature: long long process(int chosen[], int k, long long p[], int n)
clauses.code: long long process(int chosen[], int k, long long p[], int n) { long long sum = 0; for(int y = 0; y < n; y++) { long long dist = compute(y, chosen, k); sum += dist * p[y]; } return sum; }

clauses.signature: long long solve(long long p[], int n, int k)
clauses.code: long long solve(long long p[], int n, int k) { long long best = 9999999999999LL; int x[100]; for(int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) { int cnt = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) if(mask & (1 << i)) x[cnt++] = i; if(cnt != k) continue; long long val = process(x, k, p, n); if(val < best) best = val; } return best; }

clauses.signature: int main()
clauses.code: int main() { int k; long long p[50000]; int n = read_input(&k, p); printf("%lld\n", solve(p, n, k)); return 0; }

clauses.signature: void read_input(int *n, int *k, long long prob[])
clauses.code: void read_input(int *n, int *k, long long prob[]) { scanf("%d%d", n, k); for(int i = 0; i < *n; i++) scanf("%lld", &prob[i]); }

clauses.signature: long long compute(int y, int x[], int k)
clauses.code: long long compute(int y, int x[], int k) { long long res = 100000; for(int i = 0; i < k; i++) { long long d = y - x[i]; if(d < 0) d = -d; if(d < res) res = d; } return res; }

clauses.signature: long long process(int x[], int k, long long prob[], int n)
clauses.code: long long process(int x[], int k, long long prob[], int n) { long long total = 0; for(int y = 0; y < n; y++) { total += compute(y, x, k) * prob[y]; } return total; }

clauses.signature: long long solve(long long prob[], int n, int k)
clauses.code: long long solve(long long prob[], int n, int k) { long long best = 9999999999999LL; int x[100]; for(int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) { int cnt = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) if(mask & (1 << i)) x[cnt++] = i; if(cnt != k) continue; long long val = process(x, k, prob, n); if(val < best) best = val; } return best; }

clauses.signature: int main()
clauses.code: int main() { int n, k; long long prob[50000]; get_data(&n, &k, prob); printf("%lld\n", solve(prob, n, k)); return 0; }

clauses.signature: int read_input(int *num_k, long long arr[])
clauses.code: int read_input(int *num_k, long long arr[]) { int num_n; scanf("%d%d", &num_n, num_k); for(int i = 0; i < num_n; i++) scanf("%lld", &arr[i]); return num_n; }

clauses.signature: long long compute(int pos, int positions[], int cnt)
clauses.code: long long compute(int pos, int positions[], int cnt) { long long min_d = 999999; for(int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) { long long d = pos > positions[j] ? pos - positions[j] : positions[j] - pos; if(d < min_d) min_d = d; } return min_d; }

clauses.signature: long long process(int positions[], int cnt, long long arr[], int n)
clauses.code: long long process(int positions[], int cnt, long long arr[], int n) { long long e = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) e += compute(i, positions, cnt) * arr[i]; return e; }

clauses.signature: long long solve(long long arr[], int n, int k)
clauses.code: long long solve(long long arr[], int n, int k) { long long ans = 1e18; int pos[100]; for(int bits = 0; bits < (1<<n); bits++) { int c = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) if(bits & (1<<i)) pos[c++] = i; if(c == k) { long long v = process(pos, k, arr, n); ans = v < ans ? v : ans; } } return ans; }

clauses.signature: int main()
clauses.code: int main() { int num_k; long long arr[50000]; int num_n = input(&num_k, arr); printf("%lld\n", solve(arr, num_n, num_k)); return 0; }

clauses.signature: void read_input(int *sz, int *sel, long long vals[])
clauses.code: void read_input(int *sz, int *sel, long long vals[]) { scanf("%d%d", sz, sel); for(int i = 0; i < *sz; i++) scanf("%lld", vals + i); }

clauses.signature: long long compute(int target, int locs[], int num)
clauses.code: long long compute(int target, int locs[], int num) { long long best = 1000000; for(int i = 0; i < num; i++) { long long gap = target - locs[i]; if(gap < 0) gap = -gap; if(gap < best) best = gap; } return best; }

clauses.signature: long long process(int locs[], int num, long long vals[], int sz)
clauses.code: long long process(int locs[], int num, long long vals[], int sz) { long long result = 0; for(int t = 0; t < sz; t++) result += compute(t, locs, num) * vals[t]; return result; }

clauses.signature: long long solve(long long vals[], int sz, int sel)
clauses.code: long long solve(long long vals[], int sz, int sel) { long long minimum = 1e15; int locs[100]; for(int set = 0; set < (1 << sz); set++) { int cnt = 0; for(int b = 0; b < sz; b++) if(set & (1 << b)) locs[cnt++] = b; if(cnt != sel) continue; long long score = process(locs, sel, vals, sz); if(score < minimum) minimum = score; } return minimum; }

clauses.signature: int main()
clauses.code: int main() { int sz, sel; long long vals[50000]; scan(&sz, &sel, vals); printf("%lld\n", solve(vals, sz, sel)); return 0; }

clauses.signature: int read_input(int *k_val, long long p_arr[])
clauses.code: int read_input(int *k_val, long long p_arr[]) { int n_val; scanf("%d%d", &n_val, k_val); int idx; for(idx = 0; idx < n_val; idx++) scanf("%lld", p_arr + idx); return n_val; }

clauses.signature: long long compute(int y_pos, int x_pos[], int k_cnt)
clauses.code: long long compute(int y_pos, int x_pos[], int k_cnt) { long long min_val = 1e9; for(int i = 0; i < k_cnt; i++) { long long diff = y_pos - x_pos[i]; if(diff < 0) diff = -diff; min_val = diff < min_val ? diff : min_val; } return min_val; }

clauses.signature: long long process(int x_pos[], int k_cnt, long long p_arr[], int n_val)
clauses.code: long long process(int x_pos[], int k_cnt, long long p_arr[], int n_val) { long long sum_total = 0; for(int y = 0; y < n_val; y++) sum_total += compute(y, x_pos, k_cnt) * p_arr[y]; return sum_total; }

clauses.signature: long long solve(long long p_arr[], int n_val, int k_val)
clauses.code: long long solve(long long p_arr[], int n_val, int k_val) { long long ans_min = 1e18; int x_pos[100]; for(int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n_val); mask++) { int cnt = 0; for(int bit = 0; bit < n_val; bit++) if(mask & (1 << bit)) x_pos[cnt++] = bit; if(cnt == k_val) { long long cur = process(x_pos, k_val, p_arr, n_val); ans_min = cur < ans_min ? cur : ans_min; } } return ans_min; }

clauses.signature: int main()
clauses.code: int main() { int k_val; long long p_arr[50000]; int n_val = read(&k_val, p_arr); printf("%lld\n", solve(p_arr, n_val, k_val)); return 0; }
